metadata.prompt: Describe this image and judge whether it is physically reasonable.
metadata.reference: Photorealistic macro shot of a silver pocket watch resting on a polished oak desk, the watch chain drapes naturally over the edge, casting a sharp accurate shadow on the wood grain, no text, no watermark.
metadata.rationale: The chain correctly rests on top of the wood and casts a grounded contact shadow that matches the lighting direction.
